description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the OrderService interface, encapsulating business logic for processing orders in the system. It includes methods for order processing, calculating totals, managing order history, generating invoices, and handling order data persistence within the Shopizer e-commerce platform.

classes.name: OrderServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the OrderService interface, managing order processing, total calculations, invoice generation, and persistence operations within the Shopizer platform.

methods.name: addOrderStatusHistory
methods.description: Adds a new status history record to an existing order, updating its status history list.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes an order by handling payment, setting status, saving customer info, and updating transaction records.

methods.name: caculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates detailed order totals including subtotal, shipping, taxes, and grand total.

methods.name: caculateOrder
methods.description: Internal method that computes the order total details from the order summary.

methods.name: calculateShoppingCartTotal
methods.description: Computes the total amount for a shopping cart, updating individual item prices.

methods.name: generateInvoice
methods.description: Creates a PDF invoice for an order using the InvoiceModule.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists orders belonging to a specific merchant store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new order or updates an existing order record.

methods.name: hasDownloadFiles
methods.description: Checks if an order contains downloadable files in its products.
